```plato
    // The signed distance from a point to a capped cone (a conical frustum) centred
    // at the origin with its axis along Y: bottomRadius at y = -halfHeight,
    // topRadius at y = +halfHeight. Equal radii degenerate to a cylinder and a zero
    // radius to a cone with its apex on the axis, so this subsumes both. Exact.
    // Precondition: halfHeight and both radii are non-negative.
    // (IQ: sdCappedCone.)
    DistanceToCappedCone(p: Point3D, halfHeight: Number, bottomRadius: Number, topRadius: Number): Number {
        var q = Vector2D(Vector2D(p.X, p.Z).Magnitude, p.Y);
        var rim = Vector2D(topRadius, halfHeight);
        var taper = Vector2D(topRadius - bottomRadius, 2.0 * halfHeight);
        var capRadius = q.Y < 0.0 ? bottomRadius : topRadius;
        var toCap = Vector2D(q.X - q.X.Min(capRadius), q.Y.Abs - halfHeight);
        var toSide = q - rim + taper * ((rim - q).Dot(taper) / taper.LengthSquared).Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        var inside = toSide.X < 0.0 && toCap.Y < 0.0;
        return toCap.LengthSquared.Min(toSide.LengthSquared).Sqrt * (inside ? -1.0 : 1.0);
    }

    // The signed distance from a point to an axis-aligned ellipsoid with the given
    // semi-axis radii, centred at the origin. A LOWER BOUND, not exact: an
    // ellipsoid has no closed-form signed distance, and this under-estimates, which
    // keeps it safe for sphere tracing at the cost of shorter steps. Precondition:
    // every radius is positive, and p is not the centre. (IQ: sdEllipsoid.)
    DistanceToEllipsoid(p: Point3D, radii: Vector3D): Number {
        var scaled = Vector3D(p.X / radii.X, p.Y / radii.Y, p.Z / radii.Z).Magnitude;
        var gradient = Vector3D(
            p.X / (radii.X * radii.X),
            p.Y / (radii.Y * radii.Y),
            p.Z / (radii.Z * radii.Z)).Magnitude;
        return scaled * (scaled - 1.0) / gradient;
    }

    //==
    // # Unsigned distance primitives for flat patches in space
    //
    // A triangle or a quadrilateral in space is a ZERO-THICKNESS patch: it has a
    // boundary but no interior, so there is no inside for a sign to report. These
    // bodies return the unsigned distance to the patch — non-negative everywhere and
    // zero exactly on it — and the name says so. Subtract a half-thickness to get a
    // genuine solid: the result is the patch's Minkowski sum with a ball, a rounded
    // plate whose distance is exact.
    //
    // Both work the same way: the three (or four) edge half-plane tests decide
    // whether the query projects INSIDE the patch. When it does, the answer is the
    // perpendicular distance to the patch's plane; when it does not, it is the
    // distance to the nearest edge segment. Under the same portability rules as the
    // rest of the primitive family.

    // The unsigned distance from a point to the triangle patch with the given
    // vertices. Zero on the patch, positive everywhere else; a degenerate
    // (collinear) triangle has a zero normal, which fails the inside test and leaves
    // the edge branch — the right answer for a shape that is a segment. Exact.
    // (IQ: udTriangle.)
    UnsignedDistanceToTriangle(p: Point3D, a: Point3D, b: Point3D, c: Point3D): Number {
        var ba = a.Between(b);
        var cb = b.Between(c);
        var ac = c.Between(a);
        var pa = a.Between(p);
        var pb = b.Between(p);
        var pc = c.Between(p);
        var normal = ba.Cross(ac);
        var insideVotes = ba.Cross(normal).Dot(pa).Sign
                        + cb.Cross(normal).Dot(pb).Sign
                        + ac.Cross(normal).Dot(pc).Sign;
        var toEdges = EdgeOffset(ba, pa).LengthSquared
            .Min(EdgeOffset(cb, pb).LengthSquared)
            .Min(EdgeOffset(ac, pc).LengthSquared);
        var toPlane = normal.Dot(pa) * normal.Dot(pa) / normal.LengthSquared;
        return (insideVotes < 2 ? toEdges : toPlane).Sqrt;
    }

    // The unsigned distance from a point to the quadrilateral patch with the given
    // vertices in ring order. Exact for a planar quad. For a non-planar one the
    // plane branch measures against the plane through A, B and D, which the fourth
    // corner has left — that is NOT a bound, so prefer the two triangles of the
    // patch's triangulation when the corners are not coplanar. (IQ: udQuad.)
    UnsignedDistanceToQuad(p: Point3D, a: Point3D, b: Point3D, c: Point3D, d: Point3D): Number {
        var ba = a.Between(b);
        var cb = b.Between(c);
        var dc = c.Between(d);
        var ad = d.Between(a);
        var pa = a.Between(p);
        var pb = b.Between(p);
        var pc = c.Between(p);
        var pd = d.Between(p);
        var normal = ba.Cross(ad);
        var insideVotes = ba.Cross(normal).Dot(pa).Sign
                        + cb.Cross(normal).Dot(pb).Sign
                        + dc.Cross(normal).Dot(pc).Sign
                        + ad.Cross(normal).Dot(pd).Sign;
        var toEdges = EdgeOffset(ba, pa).LengthSquared
            .Min(EdgeOffset(cb, pb).LengthSquared)
            .Min(EdgeOffset(dc, pc).LengthSquared)
            .Min(EdgeOffset(ad, pd).LengthSquared);
        var toPlane = normal.Dot(pa) * normal.Dot(pa) / normal.LengthSquared;
        return (insideVotes < 3 ? toEdges : toPlane).Sqrt;
    }

    // The offset from a query to its nearest point on one edge, given the edge
    // vector and the vector from that edge's start to the query: the projection
    // parameter clamped to the segment. The shared step of the two patch bodies
    // above, kept apart so neither repeats it three or four times.
    EdgeOffset(edge: Vector3D, toQuery: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => edge * (edge.Dot(toQuery) / edge.LengthSquared).Clamp(0.0, 1.0) - toQuery;

    //==
    // # Planar signed distance primitives
    //
    // The planar half of the primitive family, under the same portability rules as
    // the spatial one above: scalar and fixed-arity vector arithmetic only. Each is
    // the 2D counterpart of a spatial primitive — circle to sphere, ring to torus,
    // line to plane — except that the 2D box already serves as the cylinder, which
    // is why there is no separate planar capped-cylinder form.

    // The signed distance from a point to a circle of the given radius centred at
    // the origin. Exact. (IQ: sdCircle.)
    DistanceToCircle(p: Point2D, radius: Number): Number
        => p.PositionVector.Magnitude - radius;

    // The signed distance from a point to an axis-aligned rectangle with the given
    // half-extents, centred at the origin. Exterior is the length of the positive
    // per-axis offsets, interior the least negative one. Exact. (IQ: sdBox.)
    DistanceToBox(p: Point2D, halfExtents: Vector2D): Number {
        var q = Vector2D(p.X.Abs - halfExtents.X, p.Y.Abs - halfExtents.Y);
        return Vector2D(q.X.Max(0.0), q.Y.Max(0.0)).Magnitude
             + q.X.Max(q.Y).Min(0.0);
    }

    // The signed distance from a point to an axis-aligned rectangle whose corners
    // are rounded by radius. As in the spatial form, halfExtents describes the
    // rectangle before rounding. Exact. (IQ: sdRoundedBox.)
    DistanceToRoundedBox(p: Point2D, halfExtents: Vector2D, radius: Number): Number {
        var q = Vector2D(
            p.X.Abs - halfExtents.X + radius,
            p.Y.Abs - halfExtents.Y + radius);
        return Vector2D(q.X.Max(0.0), q.Y.Max(0.0)).Magnitude
             + q.X.Max(q.Y).Min(0.0)
             - radius;
    }

    // The signed distance from a point to a ring centred at the origin: the circle
    // of the given radius thickened by half of thickness on each side. The planar
    // counterpart of the torus. Exact. (IQ: sdAnnulus.)
    DistanceToRing(p: Point2D, radius: Number, thickness: Number): Number
        => (p.PositionVector.Magnitude - radius).Abs - thickness * 0.5;

    // The signed distance from a point to a planar capsule: the segment from a to b
    // thickened by radius. Exact. (IQ: sdSegment.)
    DistanceToCapsule(p: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D, radius: Number): Number
        => DistanceToSegment(a, b, p) - radius;

    // The signed distance from a point to the line with the given unit normal at
    // signed offset from the origin — the planar counterpart of DistanceToPlane,
    // and the boundary of a half-plane. Exact. Precondition: normal has unit
    // length.
    DistanceToLine(p: Point2D, normal: Vector2D, offset: Number): Number
        => p.PositionVector.Dot(normal) + offset;
```
